High-fidelity Image-to-3D with complex topology: Use this family when you need to generate 3D assets from a single 2D image that include complex topologies, sharp features, or open surfaces, as standard iso-surface methods (SDF, Flexicubes) struggle with these [MODEL.md].
   PBR Material Generation: Use this family when the output requires full Physical-Based Rendering (PBR) materials, including albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, and opacity/translucency [MODEL.md].
